chars.story: Water spreading wide as a flock on a plain: ocean.
chars.note: Also 'foreign': 洋人 'foreigner'.

chars.story: Water seeping in a little at a time: gradually.
chars.note: 漸 had 斬; 渐 uses 斩.

chars.story: Water spilling over its banks with nothing to hold it: unrestrained.
chars.note: Reads as 'rambling, drifting': 漫长 is long and drawn out.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 又 and 土 stacked (sound)
chars.story: A pool of still water in low ground: a marsh.
chars.note: 澤 had a longer right side; 泽 shares its right half with 译.

chars.story: Water stirred up with mud: mix.
Water heaving up into a wave: a breaker.
chars.note: In 浪费 'waste' it means 'spend carelessly'.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 九 nine + 木 wood
chars.story: Cloth dipped nine times in water boiled with bark: dye.
chars.note: Also 'catch (a disease)'.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Two strokes at the left: speech.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 又 and 土 stacked (sound)
chars.story: Words carried over from one language to another: translate.
chars.note: 譯: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words nailed down: an order, a booking.
chars.note: Also 'subscribe' and 'revise'. 訂: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Whispered words about a certain matter: a scheme.
chars.note: 謀: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words that put a name to a thing: be called.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'call'. Mostly 所谓 'so-called' now. 謂: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: A heart that jumps: startled.
chars.note: 驚 had 馬 below; 惊 uses 忄.

chars.story: Something lost from the heart: forget.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects.

chars.story: A heart that gets it: understand.
A heart in no hurry: slow.
A trunk set upright: a tree.
chars.note: 樹 had 尌; 树 uses 对. Also 'set up': 树立.

chars.story: Timber laid across a river: a bridge.
chars.note: 橋: 喬 became 乔.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 木 tree + 木 tree
chars.story: Three trees: a forest.
chars.note: Almost always in 森林.

chars.story: A pine whose branches hang loose and easy.
chars.note: Also 'pine tree'. 鬆 had hair 髟 on top; 松 has 木.

chars.story: Feet working through the woods until the way is clear: clearly.
chars.note: Almost only in 清楚. Also the ancient state of Chu.

chars.story: A thread tying two people together: introduce them.
chars.note: Used almost only in 介绍. 紹: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: Silk dyed the color of leaves: green.
chars.note: 綠: 糸 became 纟.

chars.parts: 幺 thread + 幺 thread + 一 bar
chars.story: Two threads of silk on a loom.
chars.note: 絲 had two 糸; 丝 keeps two small threads. 粉丝 'fan' is a loan from 'fans'.

chars.story: Fibers matted like thread into a sheet: paper.
chars.note: 紙: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: A person leaning against a tree: rest.
A person who is not tied to the world: the Buddha.
chars.note: In 仿佛 'as if' it means 'like'.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 𠬶 hand with a broom
chars.story: A person sweeping across another's ground with a broom: invade.
Father 父 on top and a dad below.

chars.parts: - a hand-shaped top over 女 woman
chars.story: A hand brings a woman home: wife.
chars.note: 妻子 can also mean 'wife and children' in older texts.

chars.story: A person whose hair is going white: father's elder brother.
chars.note: Also 'count' as a noble title: 伯爵 earl.

chars.story: Walking right through to the other side: penetrate.
Walking away from trouble: shun.
A road of scattered grains, and you lose your way: bewildered.
chars.note: Also 'fan, devotee': 球迷, 歌迷.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A box on the left: voice and speech.

chars.story: A mouth in full bloom: sing.
Words wrapped up around a mouth: a sentence.
chars.note: Counts sentences: 一句话.

chars.story: A mouth-sign pulled onto the end of a sentence: a cheerful tag.
chars.note: Merges 了 and 啊: 好啦 'all right!'.

chars.story: A bamboo stem tipped with hair: a brush, now any pen.
chars.note: 筆: 聿 became 毛.

chars.story: Flat bamboo slips written on: a piece of writing.
chars.note: Counts articles: 一篇文章.

chars.story: Each passer is looked over at the gate: peruse.
chars.note: 閱: 門 became 门.

chars.story: Words chanted in measured lines, as in a temple: a poem.
chars.note: 詩: 訁 became 讠.

chars.parts: - a shell with two legs below a box
chars.story: A shell with legs: the old money.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'shell'. 貝 became 贝. As a part, it marks money.

chars.story: Shell-money changing hands: trade.
chars.note: 貿 had 卯 and 貝.

chars.story: Grain handed over to the ruler: taxes.
chars.note: 稅: 禾 and 兌, with 兑 simplified.

chars.story: Streams drawn into one channel: converge, remit.
chars.note: 匯 and 彙 both became 汇. In 词汇 it gathers words.

chars.story: Sharp words and blows: an enemy.
chars.note: 敵 had 啇; 敌 uses 舌.

chars.story: Fire bursting out: blow up.
chars.note: Also 'deep-fry': 炸鸡 'fried chicken'.

chars.parts: 臼 mortar + 工 work + 殳 club
chars.story: A club pounds the mortar to bits: destroy.
chars.note: 毀 had 土 in the middle; 毁 has 工.

chars.story: A lid pressed over a fire: put it out.
chars.note: 滅 had 氵 and 戌; 灭 keeps just 一 and 火.

chars.parts: 亡 + 口 + 月 + 贝 shell + 凡
chars.story: A pile of shell-money in your hands while the rivals are lost: win.
chars.note: 贏 and 赢 differ only in the shell.

groups.title: give and take
groups.note: Passing things on, or losing them.

chars.story: One hand hooks a thing over to another: give.
chars.note: A bookish 'give', found in compounds. The literary word for 给 'give'.

chars.story: A person takes what was once another's: borrow.
chars.note: Also 'lend', and 'use as': 借口 'an excuse'.

chars.story: A hand held out to pull someone up: lend aid.
A hand chipping away at a thing: damage.
chars.note: 損: 貝 became 贝 inside 员.

chars.parts: 亠 lid + 廾 two hands
chars.story: Two hands lift a lid and throw the thing away: abandon.
chars.note: 棄 had a child and a tree; 弃 keeps the lid and the hands.

chars.parts: 艹 + 月 flesh + 攵 tap
chars.story: Blows tapping at flesh until the pieces fly apart: scatter.
chars.note: Also 'loose': 散文 'prose'.

chars.story: A big roof where guests are received.
chars.note: 廳 had a big 聽 inside; 厅 kept only 广 and 丁.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 吕 linked rooms
chars.story: A roof over rows of linked rooms: a palace.
chars.note: 宮 and 宫 are the same outline.

chars.story: Earth stacked up level on level: a pagoda.
A cloth hung up: a curtain or screen.

chars.parts: 宀 roof over a stack of strokes
chars.story: A rule set up under one roof, binding all: constitution.
chars.note: 憲 had 心 and 害 under a roof; 宪 shrank it.

chars.story: A knife held to a frame: punishment.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'punishment'. Same meaning today, in legal terms.

chars.story: Cutting cloth to make a garment: cut out, decide.
chars.note: Also 'lay off': 裁员.

chars.story: Grass above a base: a character kept for Buddhist and foreign names.
chars.note: Used only in transliterations: 菩萨, 披萨.

chars.story: A river-name character, now used for foreign names such as Los Angeles.
chars.note: Mostly in foreign names. Also a river and a surname.

chars.story: A fish left out in the sun, coarse and spoiled: rude.
chars.note: Also short for Shandong and a surname. 魯 had 白 and 魚.

chars.story: Leather straps and strength: rein in.
chars.note: Also a spelling character in foreign names, e.g. 希特勒 (Hitler).

chars.story: A lid on a dish: cover.
chars.note: 蓋 had 艹 grass on top; 盖 has a lid. Also 'build': 盖房子.

chars.story: A mound across the path: a barrier.
A gate with a bar across: shut.
chars.note: 閉: 門 became 门.

chars.story: Grass heaped over a thing, hiding it: covered over, in the dark.
chars.note: Mostly 'cover', 'suffer' and 'Mongolia'.

chars.parts: 廴 long stride + 止 stop
chars.story: A long stride taken further: prolong.
A person at your heels: urge on.
A mouth calling sharp as a blade: summon.

chars.parts: - a line stretched through a frame
chars.story: A rod pulled out through a frame: stretch it out, state it.
chars.note: Also short for Shanghai, and a surname.

chars.story: Goods laid out along a mound: display.
chars.note: Also the very common surname Chen. 陳: 東 became 东.

chars.story: Running to close the gap: catch up.
chars.note: 趕: 旱 became 干.

chars.story: A door swung open: start up.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'open up'. Modern 启 is 'start up': 启动 'launch', 启发 'inspire'. 啟 had 攵; 启 dropped it.

chars.story: Knowing brought into daylight: wisdom.
The sickness sign and an ache that won't let go: pain.

chars.parts: 酉 wine jar + 星 star
chars.story: The wine wears off at starlight: you wake up.
The fleshy part that steps away: the foot.
chars.note: Also 'base': 山脚 'foot of a hill'. 腳 had 却 too.

chars.parts: 歹 + 又 over 食 food
chars.story: Food laid out and hands reaching for it: a meal.
chars.note: Counts meals.

chars.story: Horned head, body and legs: a cow.
chars.note: Slang: 牛 'amazing'.

chars.story: Cooked over fire until done: ripe.
chars.note: Also 'cooked' and 'well known': 熟人 'acquaintance'.

chars.story: Plucked flowers and shimmering strokes beside them: bright color.
The sun gone, a hush: dark.

chars.parts: 页 head (changed) + 夂 slow foot
chars.story: A slow foot dragging under a wide hat in the heat: summer.
Ice: cold.
Where nothing contends and all is green: quiet.
chars.note: 靜: 爭 became 争, 青 kept.

chars.story: Old walls that have stood for ages: solid.
Earth lying open and even at dawn: open and level.
chars.note: Also 'open-hearted'.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 冖 cover + 木 wood
chars.story: A tree crowned with blossom: glory.
chars.note: 榮 had two flames on top; 荣 has 艹 and 冖.

chars.story: A carpenter's big square: huge.
A nail driven into the top of the head: the top.
chars.note: 頂: 頁 became 页.

chars.parts: - an ear of grain with full rows
chars.story: An ear of grain heavy with kernels: abundant.
chars.note: 豐 was much more elaborate.

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Little words that join a sentence.

chars.parts: 皀 bowl + 旡 turned-away person
chars.story: A man turns his back on the empty bowl: it is done, since it is done.
chars.note: Also 'already'; 既…又… means 'both…and…'.

chars.parts: - a bent shape with a dot
chars.story: One mark that stands out above the rest: especially.
A single bird calling alone: the sole one.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects. Modern 唯 is formal.

chars.story: Beyond the village, land that gives only to the wild.
Rain over the fields, and the sky booms: thunder.

sentences.en: The tree is green all year round.
It is too dark to see clearly.
He lost his way in the woods.
How would you like your steak?
That river flows into the Pacific.
Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

sentences.zh: 我在这家餐厅订了位子。
sentences.en: I booked a seat at this restaurant.

sentences.zh: 此刻，你正在阅读并翻译这句。
sentences.en: At this very moment, you're reading and translating this.

sentences.zh: 请不要做任何有损松野家族名声的事！
sentences.en: Please don't do anything that would besmirch the Matsuno family name!

sentences.zh: 这笔交易是我的，所以你需要去冷静并且同意我
sentences.en: This deal is mine, so you need to just settle down and agree with me.
